name: dsh-lan-proxy
description: DSH web plugin: LAN reverse proxy for the DSH web UI (default 0.0.0.0:15151 -> 127.0.0.1:3080, Host/Origin rewritten to loopback, crypto.randomUUID polyfill injected). Starts automatically with DSH; mobile/narrow-screen friends can open http://<LAN-IP>:15151 for a full working UI.
